name: fire salamander
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-08, tools/creaturegen/herps/salamander.py): the FIRE SALAMANDER, Salamandra salamandra, 20 cm, the tail a little shorter than the body. Stout and rounded: a broad flat rounded head, a blunt snout, big black protruding eyes, the PAROTOID glands bulging behind them (kidney-shaped, diverging backward); a thick round trunk with shallow costal grooves down the flanks; short sturdy sprawled legs, four blunt fingers in front and five toes behind (round tips, no claws); a tail round in section, thick at the root, tapering to a blunt point (one `sweep`), lying on the ground. Smooth WET skin (`wet`), glossy black with bright yellow blotches (paints): over the eyelids and the parotoids, two irregular rows down the back, a few on the flanks, one on each upper leg, two rows down the tail. Coats: spotted yellow (base), striped yellow (S. s. terrestris / fastuosa: two continuous wavy dorsolateral stripes from the parotoids onto the tail, `when: striped`), the rare orange-red one. A slow walk, the trunk and tail swinging side to side.
